title: IFL City Challenge
game_overview: Navigate high-stakes urban English conversations, solve timed grammar challenges, and advance your career in the city.
winning_condition: Successfully complete all 3 scenario chapters with a passing score of at least 70% accuracy.
losing_condition: Fail to answer correctly before the scenario timer expires across 3 consecutive strikes.

controls.action: Select dialogue options, interact with grammar tokens, and submit responses.
Confirm selected answer or advance conversation.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Authentic Professional Immersion: Recreate realistic modern corporate, banking, and cafe environments with photorealistic visual fidelity. 2. Low-Stress High-Engagement Learning: Timed 30-second rapid-fire questions foster instinctual language recall without paralyzing the learner. 3. Immediate Constructive Feedback: Clear audio-visual rewards for correct grammar and helpful interactive retry prompts for mistakes.
sections.summary: Core pedagogical and experiential design values.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: The player chooses or enters an urban scenario (Specialty Cafe -> Bank Consultation -> Corporate Networking Mixer). An NPC speaks in natural English dialogue posing a situation. A 30-second interactive challenge overlay appears focusing on Lesson 3 (Months of the Year) and Lesson 4 (Possessive Adjectives & Pronouns: my, your, his, her, our, their, mine, yours). Player submits their choice via multiple choice or slot-filling. Immediate feedback displays grammar notes, awards points/reputation, and unlocks the next conversational branch.
sections.summary: Primary cycle of scenario progression, grammar challenge, and evaluation.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. Rapid-Fire 30s Countdown: A sleek circular radial timer counts down from 30 seconds; faster answers award bonus speed points. 2. Grammar Slot Assembler & Multiple Choice: Dynamic fill-in-the-blank tokens (possessives & calendar months) and situational dialog trees. 3. Professional Confidence Meter: Correct answers boost confidence and score multiplier; errors pause time and present grammar coaching cards. 4. Scenario Branching: Three distinct workplace & daily life hubs with varied conversational stakes.
sections.summary: Interactive language test systems and scoring.

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: Static Screen / Bounded Arena presentation with horizontal smooth slide scene transitions. Asset Orientation: Characters are framed in portrait/half-body view facing slightly towards center stage to directly address the player. Movement Physics: Kinetic UI animations with spring easing for dialogue cards and question pop-ups. Camera Behavior: Locked cinematic focal framing on the active speaker and conversational environment.
sections.summary: Fixed camera visual novel and interactive dialogue framing.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Layer Separation: Background layer features softly blurred photorealistic urban interiors (coffee shop, glass banking lobby, evening mixer terrace). Playfield/Character layer hosts crisp, high-contrast photorealistic human character sprites. HUD/Interactive layer uses frosted glassmorphic response cards, high-contrast gold/teal action buttons, and clear typography (Inter / Roboto) for optimal readability on all screen sizes.
sections.summary: Clean modern corporate aesthetic and distinct UI layering.

sections.title: Characters & Enemies
sections.content: 1. Barista Elena: Friendly, articulate specialty cafe barista asking about seasonal drink schedules and loyalty card ownership. 2. Financial Consultant David: Sharp, professional bank advisor discussing fiscal quarterly appointments and account documentation. 3. Senior Associate Chloe: Polished marketing director at the downtown networking mixer discussing team projects and collaborative timelines.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: 1. Grammar Hint Tooltip: Learners can hover or tap a lightbulb icon to view a quick reference rule for possessive pronouns. 2. Audio Pronunciation Button: Tap to replay spoken question prompts. 3. Second Chance Option: If an error is made, a gentle hint highlights the grammar rule before a 50% score retry.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Soft glowing button hover states and ticking sound effects during the final 5 seconds of the countdown. State Change Juice: Smooth slide-in of dialogue cards and green pulse outline on correct choices. Impact Juice: Satisfying chime on correct submission with floating score numbers and celebratory dialogue animation.

sections.title: Social Mechanics & Audience
sections.content: Designed specifically for adult learners (ages 18-44) practicing practical everyday and workplace English. Features end-of-session evaluation report cards with CEFR-aligned performance grades and exportable achievement summaries.
sections.summary: Adult ESL and professional language learners.

sections.title: Accessibility
sections.content: Full keyboard navigation (1-4 keys for selection, Enter to submit), high-contrast text subtitles, customizable text sizing, and optional timer pause mode for assisted learning.

sections.title: Structural Integrity
sections.content: Flow: Title Screen & Scenario Selection -> Scenario Narrative Dialogue -> Timed Grammar Challenge -> Immediate Explanation & Feedback -> Scenario Summary & Score Review -> Next Chapter -> Graduation Results Screen.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Render large, touch-friendly answer cards (minimum 48px height) with touch-none CSS to prevent accidental viewport drag. Use pointer-events-auto strictly on button elements to keep UI responsive on mobile devices.
sections.summary: Mobile responsive touch overlay and tap targets.
